description: How a reader checks who sent a message (docs/40 §14.5, §15.2; a case may set signed_before and its own now): core checkSender / pinAfterCheck / autoReplyBlock and the Rust gateway. Lists are signed with Ed25519 seeds all-0x01 (root) and all-0x02 (other root); messages by all-0x03 (the sender's computer) or all-0x04 (a stranger). `now` is fixed.

cases.name: verified: first time, the pin starts
verified: the pin moves forward
verified: the sender's own copy
verified: removed since, but listed when sent
verified: no list version stored, the current list names the device
unsigned: no v2 signature
altered: the server added a key wrap
altered: the content type was changed
altered: the thread was changed
altered: an attachment was dropped
altered: for another agent
altered: signed by a key other than the sender DID's
altered: sent more than 10 minutes in the future
altered: the server resolves the sender to another agent
no_list: the sender has no device list
broken: the list disappeared
broken: the list does not verify
broken: an older list than seen before
broken: the sent-with list is newer than the current one
root_changed: the list is signed by another root
not_listed: the signing device is not on the list
downgraded: no signature from a sender seen signing before (stage 5)
missing_signature: no signature after 2027-02-11 (stage 5)
